                                   Resolution 2022-25
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR THE GIRDWOOD COMMUNITY CLUB'S
             CONTINUATION OF A NO-FEE REVOCABLE USE PERMIT
                FOR THEIR FACILITIES IN GIRDWOOD PARK

WHEREAS, the Girdwood Community Club (GCC), a non-profit 501 (C) (3), needs to retain its home for its Community
FM radio station and other projects; and

WHEREAS, the Girdwood Community Club (GCC) has organized and supported, by deed and action, community
enrichment projects for the past 70 years including Girdwood's first school, fire department, alpine ski area, library,
theater group, relay television broadcasts, FM radio station, and community parks; and

WHEREAS, the club's current goal is to promote education, information and communication in Girdwood and the
Turnagain Arm area and operate community broadcast facilities and other non-profit communication and educational
services; and

WHEREAS, the residents of this valley, through the club, have had in the past an abundance of land and buildings at their
disposal for implementing its projects; and

WHEREAS, the Club's original building is on land subsumed by the Municipality of Anchorage during "Unification" in
the mid 1970's, subsequently dedicated as Girdwood Park; and

WHEREAS, the Club owns said building which was originally built by the Community Club for its and the community’s
activities; and

WHEREAS, the Girdwood Community Club requests a continuation of its ‘no fee permit’ to maintain a minimum of
overhead with maximum ability to continue service to the community; and

WHEREAS, the Anchorage Municipal Assembly passed AO No. 2012-36, “An Ordinance Authorizing a Revocable Use
Permit to Girdwood Community Club, Inc., a non-profit corporation, on premises located on dedicated park land at 124
Egloff Drive in Girdwood,” including Assembly Memorandum AM 193-2012 which directs, “The Girdwood Community
Club, Inc. shall receive a rent-free Permit for the term of the permit to continue use of the facility currently being operated
as a multi-purpose community center ”, and

WHEREAS, this resolution is recommended by the Girdwood Land Use Committee by unanimous vote at their regular
meeting of November 14, 2022;

NOW, THEREFORE, THE GIRDWOOD BOARD OF SUPERVISORS RESOLVES:

THAT THE GIRDWOOD BOARD OF SUPERVISORS GIVES ITS SUPPORT TO THESE PROJECTS AND
RECOMMENDS TO THE MUCICIPALITY OF ANCHORAGE A CONTINUATION OF THE NO-FEE REVOCABLE
USE PERMIT TO ACCOMODATE THE NEEDS OF THE GIRDWOOD COMMUNITY CLUB.

PASSED AND APPROVED this 21st day of November 2022





                                                  November 22, 2022
Mike Edgington
GBOS Land Use Chair                                    Date
